lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Apricot Business Lounge is after security in the Terminal 2 international departures area and is open round the clock. A visit lasts no more than 4 consecutive hours: passengers over 12 pay VND 945,000; children aged 5 to 12 inclusive pay VND 472,500. The lounge has a buffet, drinks, massage chairs, showers and Wi-Fi.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: SASCO Sleep Zone is after security in the Terminal 2 international departures hall near gate 27 and is open round the clock. A room costs VND 180,000 per hour; the minimum use is 2 hours. Rooms have a single bed, fan and power outlet; a cooling towel and a bottle of mineral water are provided.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: FreeWifi TanSonNhat AirPort is available free of charge in the public areas of the domestic and international terminals. The connection operates round the clock with no time limit.
